pages.text: $(item)Penicillin$() — the universal antibiotic, nemesis of syphilis and other bacterial infections. A travel essential.

$(item)Chemotherapy Drug$() — course-based treatment for ovarian cancer; each dose cuts 3 days of progression and also suppresses breast cancer.$(br2)Chemo hurts the patient too though: nausea, weakness, some HP loss and even $(#FF69B4)hair loss$()...
$(item)Tamsulosin Capsule$() — specialized relief for prostatitis, urethritis and urine buildup. No need to panic at every bathroom trip.
$(item)Sanitary Towel$() — only usable while menstruating; grants a comfy effect lasting up to $(#FF69B4)10 minutes$().$(br2)Take good care of yourself during that time of the month, meow~
